issue: RISK-03.3G-01 (Issue #6), point 2: reproducible FLEXPART-11.1 test corpus

oracle.note: Unmodified upstream sources only. Verification via cargo run --bin reference-check and scripts/compare-fortran.sh / scripts/run-corpus.sh.

candidate_production_path: ForwardTimeLoopDriver (src/simulation/timeloop.rs): WGSL dual-wind advection + fused Hanna/Langevin (n_substeps=4) + GPU PBL diagnostics + dry/wet deposition forcing. Isolated kernel dispatches (advection-only, Langevin-only, deposition-only, convection-workflow) are labeled isolated and are not full production runs.
seed_note: Candidate Philox key/counter are controllable per case (see cases/*.json). The Fortran oracle hard-codes its RNG seeds (random_mod.f90 alloc_random: iseed1=-7-i, iseed2=-88-i) with no namelist override; multi-seed oracle parity cannot be claimed. Stochastic corpus cases run the candidate with 10 independent Philox seeds and compare diagnostically against a single oracle realization.

cases.title: Analytic advection without turbulence

candidate.path: isolated WGSL advection dispatches (production advection kernel, turbulence disabled by construction)
candidate.runner: cargo test --test integration corpus_analytic_advection && scripts/run-corpus.sh candidate ADV-ANA-001

cases.expected: 10 m/s * 3600 s = 36000 m eastward displacement; no north/south or vertical motion; plume does not spread; mass conserved.
cases.units: wind m/s, displacement m, mass kg

cases.title: Uniform wind with horizontal and vertical turbulence

oracle.runner: scripts/run-corpus.sh oracle WIND-UNI-002 (Docker, LTURBULENCE=1, CTL=5.0 modern Hanna, LCONVECTION=0)

cases.expected: Center of mass advects east/south with 5/-3 m/s wind; plume spreads in x/y/z; all particles remain in [0, BLH]; total mass conserved without deposition.
cases.units: wind m/s, positions degrees/m, mass kg

cases.title: Sheared wind with horizontal and vertical turbulence

oracle.runner: scripts/run-corpus.sh oracle WIND-SHEAR-003 (Docker, sheared synthetic GRIB via --u-shear-per-m)

cases.expected: Mean displacement follows the release-height wind; vertical shear stretches the plume along-wind (growing x-variance and x/z covariance); mass conserved; PBL confined.
cases.units: wind m/s, shear 1/s, positions degrees/m, mass kg

cases.title: Dry-only deposition

candidate.path: isolated dry-deposition kernel (analytic exponential) + production driver with dry forcing and zero wet forcing
candidate.runner: cargo test --test integration deposition_decay + src/bin/corpus-run.rs (case DRY-007)

oracle.runner: scripts/run-corpus.sh oracle DRY-007 (Docker, depositing aerosol SPECIES, zero-precipitation GRIB)

cases.expected: Total airborne mass decays exponentially with the dry-deposition rate; deposited reservoir grows complementarily; mass budget (airborne + deposited) conserved.
cases.units: deposition velocity m/s, rate 1/s, mass kg
cases.thresholds: deposition_cpu_abs / deposition_gpu_abs for isolated kernels; driver/oracle reservoir budgets gated by budget_closure_rel

cases.title: Repeatability (deterministic rerun)

candidate.path: production ForwardTimeLoopDriver run twice with identical Philox key/counter

oracle.runner: documented only: Fortran seeds are hard-coded (random_mod.f90 alloc_random) with no namelist override; OpenMP threading adds scheduling nondeterminism. No multi-seed oracle parity is claimed.

cases.expected: Candidate reruns with the same seed produce bit-identical particle states and metrics.

cases.title: Restart (continue from saved state)
cases.blocked_by: Candidate has no particle-state serialize/restore or timestep-continuation API (verified: no restart symbol in src/simulation/timeloop.rs at the corpus base commit). The Fortran oracle supports restart via IPIN/LOUTRESTART and restart_mod.f90, so no equivalent two-program restart run exists.

oracle.runner: Fortran restart documented in docs/corpus-matrix.md (IPIN path); not executed as a paired run

cases.artifacts: none (must not be reported as passed)

cases.title: Radioactive-decay analytic case
cases.blocked_by: The candidate production driver now exposes per-species decay forcing and an isolated decay kernel, but DECAY-011 has no paired candidate/Fortran analytic run or complete decayed-reservoir budget. The Fortran oracle supports decay via SPECIES PDECAY half-life. The paired corpus gate and reservoir accounting remain separate follow-up work.

candidate.path: decay lane present; paired corpus case and reservoir budget missing

cases.expected: Future gate once decay lands in both production paths: airborne mass follows exp(-lambda*t) with lambda=ln(2)/half-life; budget includes decayed reservoir.
cases.units: half-life s, decay constant 1/s, mass kg
cases.thresholds: none (must not be reported as passed)

cases.title: Convection column
cases.blocked_by: Convection is implemented only as an isolated CPU reference and WGSL mixing kernel (src/physics/convection.rs, src/gpu/convection.rs, tests/convection_chain.rs). It is not orchestrated by the candidate production driver (no convection dispatch in ForwardTimeLoopDriver at the corpus base commit). The Fortran oracle supports convection via LCONVECTION/convect43c. No convection-column run through both production paths exists.

candidate.runner: tests/convection_chain.rs (isolated, not a corpus production run)

cases.expected: Future gate once Emanuel convection lands in both production paths: bottom-heavy profile lifts, column-stochastic matrix conserves mass.
cases.units: levels m, mass flux kg/m2/s, mass kg
cases.thresholds: none (must not be reported as passed)
